khaki:
a. 卡其色的, 土黄色的
n. 卡其色, 卡其色军服

n. a sturdy twilled cloth of a yellowish brown color used especially for military uniforms
s. of a yellowish brown color
khakis: n. 卡其裤；卡其服装；卡其黄（khaki的复数）
n. a military uniform made of khaki fabric
khan: n. 可汗, 商队宿店
n. a title given to rulers or other important people in Asian countries
khartoum: n. the capital of Sudan located at the confluence of the Blue Nile and White Nile
khat:
[化] 阿拉伯茶
[医] 卡塔叶(阿拉伯茶树叶)
n the leaves of the shrub Catha edulis which are chewed like tobacco or used to make tea; has the effect of a euphoric stimulant
khedive: n. one of the Turkish viceroys who ruled Egypt between 1867 and 1914
khmer: n. 高棉人, 高棉语

n. the Mon-Khmer language spoken in Cambodia
n. a native or inhabitant of Cambodia
khomeini: n. Iranian religious leader of the Shiites; when Shah Pahlavi's regime fell Khomeini established a new constitution giving himself supreme powers (1900-1989)
khrushchev: n. Soviet statesman and premier who denounced Stalin (1894-1971)
